about: Adaptation seeds shown at /adaptations. Each slug is a folder under adaptations/ holding brief.md and, once someone makes one, script.md and shots.md. The title and line are shown before the spoiler warning, so they stay free of later-chapter reveals. spoilers_through is the last chapter the brief draws on. video_url is a finished adaptation's video, when there is one. Checked by scripts/check-adaptations.ts.
